text:
ira (PM): starting thread: rollout plan for 'adaptive regional throttling' — objective: keep tail latency SLAs while shedding non-critical load. need canary plan, flag surface, customer opt-outs, and clear rollback steps.

chen (eng): propose 3-tier flags: global toggle, region override, tenant holdback. add 'mode' with values: auto/shadow/manual.

lina (sre): agree. add telemetry tag reason_code and expose in logs. circuit: if 95p latency > X or error rate > 0.3% for 5m, trigger rollback.

raja (ml): when switching to lower-cost model variants, run a 24h shadow for quality metrics; fail if F1/drop > 1.5%. log variant id at sample-level.

maya (cs): customers want explicit opt-out and a notification webhook. enterprise customers also need an SLA amendment for throttling.

ira (PM): suggested rollout phases:
- alpha: internal + 48h shadow in us-east (2 days)
- beta: 10% invited tenants with webhook + manual kill-switch (1 week)
- gamma: ramp to 50% with auto gates (2 weeks)
- GA: defaults by tier, docs + pricing note

chen (eng): canary details: 500 reqs/region per 10m window, compare latency, error, cost-per-token. promote after 4 stable windows.

lina (sre): preflight checklist: KV cache hit test, cold-start regression, chaos test (region failure), and alert runbook linked.

raja (ml): include per-tenant micro-eval: 200 samples/day to track quality drift during shadow.

maya (cs): will draft customer-facing FAQ and opt-out flow. need copy for AMs about pricing impact.

ira (PM): decisions for this thread:
1) default mode = auto for standard tiers, enterprise = manual opt-in for auto.
2) surface cost delta in console and webhook.
3) rollback ladder = reduce scope -> shadow -> disable -> model rollback.
Vote +1/-1 or comment.

chen (eng): +1. will send flag schema spec by EOD.

lina (sre): +1. I'll draft SLO thresholds and rollback playbook.

raja (ml): +1. I'll assemble mini-eval harness.

maya (cs): +1. drafting FAQ.

ira (PM): thanks — action items assigned. planning to start alpha tomorrow morning.
